evidence: Four genuine tiers: 'No-op: start new captures without changing exported files' / 'Minimal reversible: keep old export under MyDrive-Shared as source material and create only new notes under notes/meeting-notes; optionally exclude cache/log/import artifacts' / 'Medium convention: ...materialize selected Drive history... while preserving originals' / 'Heavy migration: deduplicate Drive copies or convert the export tree only with preview, backup, and explicit approval.'
Explicit approval boundary: 'any move, rename, dedupe, import materialization, or cache-state rewrite requires explicit approval. New capture destination creation is additive.'
Raw-source preservation stated in two tiers ('preserving originals', 'keep old export... as source material').

All four manifest must_not_suggest items respected: dedupe gated to heavy tier; rename/move approval-gated; recreate people folders forbidden in do_not_do; full re-import only as optional next_action.
failures: Template headers 'Do-Not-Touch List', 'Raw Source Preservation', and 'Recommended Path For This Product Surface' are not used as explicit sections; the content exists but is distributed across tiers and structured-diagnostic do_not_do.
patch_recommendation: Minor: add the explicit Do-Not-Touch / Raw-Source-Preservation / Recommended-Path headers for checker legibility; no substantive change needed.
risk_notes: Strongest stage. Does not jump to migration; every mutation gated; raw export preserved. No risk.
